theme_and_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY mixed with ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST. A mobile-first workspace that feels like a high-end command center for Sra. Luck collaborators.
theme_and_identity.color_mode: System default with a highly polished Light theme (Pearl & Charcoal) and a deep, immersive Dark theme (Midnight & Gold).

rules: NO Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings. Use Outfit for a premium, sleek feel.
Headlines (H1-H2) MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight.
Overlines and Labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs, and wide spacing: tracking-[0.2em].
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Never use pure #000000. Use tinted darks like #0F0F12.
Success metrics (commissions, hits) must use the success_metric color for dopamine hits.
Primary CTA buttons must be high-contrast (Black in light mode, White in dark mode) with Accent color text/icons.
NO generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or subtle radial highlights.

layouts.global: Mobile-first responsive. Container max-width for desktop is max-w-5xl to keep the CRM dashboard tight and readable.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. gap-6 for grid items.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density Grid (MODE B) adapted for mobile. Mobile: grid-cols-1. Tablet: grid-cols-2. Desktop: grid-cols-3 or 4.
surfaces: Cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border. No heavy drop shadows. max 12px border-radius (rounded-xl).
Headers: Sticky top with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b). CRITICAL: NEVER use a completely transparent background for headers or overlays.

components_instructions.Shadcn_UI: Use Shadcn for interactive logic (Dialogs, Tabs, Select, Form, Calendar, Charts).
components_instructions.Customization: Strip the 'Vercel-look'. Make borders sharper or slightly rounded (rounded-xl). Replace default ring colors with the Accent color.
components_instructions.Data_Display: Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for sales/commissions trends. Keep charts minimal (hide axes where obvious, emphasize the trend line).
components_instructions.Cards: Do NOT overuse standard Shadcn Cards. Use raw divs with tight borders and bento-box layouts to avoid 'card soup'.
components_instructions.Navigation: Mobile: Bottom tab bar (glassmorphism). Desktop: Left sidebar or top navigation. Always visible.
components_instructions.Login_Screen: Single, unified login screen. Minimal bento layout. Elegant abstract background texture or blurred office environment.
components_instructions.Role_Dashboards: Render different widgets based on role (Vendedora, SDR, Financeiro) post-login. Use Tabs or distinct routes.

rules: Hover states MUST exist for all interactive elements (e.g., -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, text color shift).
List items and dashboard widgets must use staggered entrance animations (Framer Motion).
Micro-interactions on commission milestones (e.g., tiny confetti or scale-up on 'Meta atingida').
Text contrast must meet WCAG AA (APCA preferred).
Focus states must be highly visible (ring-2 ring-accent ring-offset-2).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

login_background.description: Blurred figures in a bright, abstract blue and white space - use as a subtle overlay or login background.

abstract_texture.description: Abstract white vertical lines - good for elegant light mode background textures.

office_ambient.description: Blurred hallway with lights - ambient texture for dark/premium sections.

specific_flows.login_routing: A single `/login` route. On success, check the user's role payload. If 'vendedora' -> `/dashboard/vendedora`, if 'sdr' -> `/dashboard/sdr`, if 'financeiro' -> `/dashboard/financeiro`.
specific_flows.commission_logic: Vendedora gets R$100 on first installment. SDR gets R$10 on attendance. No duplicates. Display these clearly in their respective dashboards using high-contrast metric cards.
specific_flows.notifications: Dedicated slide-over or dropdown panel for daily personalized messages and motivational history.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur, solid inner borders) for sticky headers and navigation.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium, duotone tech look. Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
Prioritize HTML/Tailwind for main structural bento grids, and Shadcn for complex forms, charts, and dialogs.
Write valid .js files, NOT .tsx (since the environment uses .js).
